name: Lily
source:
She woke up one day not being able to remember anything but her name.
In order to pay back Cecil for letting her stay at Lurunia she is working hard to help out.
She looks reserved but she has a stubborn streak. Even in an unfamiliar situation she  has an unfailing optimism.
